title: Apollo Economist: AI Yields No Financial Payoff for Most Firms
excerpt: Despite heavy investments and industry hype, artificial intelligence has failed to deliver financial returns for most corporate sectors outside of tech.
body_html:
According to an analysis by an Apollo economist, artificial intelligence has provided no financial payoff for the vast majority of corporate America outside of the technology sector.

The assessment highlights a stark contrast between heavy industry investments and widespread enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence, and the actual financial returns realized by businesses.
